श्योणाक श्योणाक or श्योनाक, अस्, m. (said
to be fr. rt. श्यै), the plant Bignonia or Calosanthes
Indica, (see शोणक.)
स्योत, अस्, m. a bag, sack, bag of coarse canvas.

स्योन, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. स्यूम below], beautiful,
pleasing, favourable, propitious, auspicious; (अस्),
m. a sack, coarse bag; a ray of light; the sun;
(अम्), n. happiness, pleasure (= सुख, Naigh.

).
—स्योन-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. one who causes hap-
piness (to guests), a hospitable person, (Sāy. = अति-
थीनां सुख-कारिन्, Ṛg-veda

.)
—स्योन-
शी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. lying or resting in a happy or
pleasant place (i. e. in a sacrificial chamber; applied
in Ṛg-veda

. to Agni, and according to
Sāy. = गार्हपत्यायतने शयानः).
